get.summary: Health of the API, the database and the worker
Minimum app version and server commit

patch.summary: Change the name or phone number of the logged-in user

delete.summary: Delete the account of the logged-in user: the name, address and phone are wiped, the sessions end. Refused for the only platform admin, and for the only coordinator of an active working group or admin of an organization (with `blockers`)

get.summary: The active working groups of all organizations
The group's pending requests with the applicants' contact details, oldest first. For its reviewers
The members of a working group by name. Email and phone only for its coordinators and admins

post.summary: Add people to a working group by email address (its coordinators, the admins of its organization and platform admins). One outcome per address; the same list again changes nothing

get.summary: The working groups you manage, with counts: all for a platform admin, those of your organizations for an admin, the ones you coordinate for a coordinator

patch.summary: Change the name, the city or whether the group is active (admins of its organization and platform admins). Saving without a change is 200 too

delete.summary: Remove a member from a working group. A coordinator may not remove a coordinator, and the last coordinator of an active group stays

patch.summary: Make a member coordinator or a plain volunteer (admins of the organization and platform admins). The last coordinator of an active group stays

get.summary: The organizations you administer: all for a platform admin, none for others

post.summary: Add an organization with its first admin (platform admins)

patch.summary: Change the contact address (its admins) or the name (platform admins). Saving without a change is 200 too

post.summary: Make someone an admin of the organization (platform admins). Also 200 when they were

delete.summary: Take the admin role away (platform admins). Never the last admin

post.summary: Add a working group with its first coordinator (admins of the organization and platform admins)

get.summary: All species, switched off or not, in Dutch order of the Dutch name

patch.summary: Change a species's names, its check, or switch it off or on (platform admins). Saving without a change is 200 too

post.summary: Ask to join a working group. Sending the same id again returns the stored request

get.summary: The pending requests of every group the user reviews, with the applicants' contact details. Empty for anyone who reviews nothing
One request, any status, for its reviewers. The applicant's contact details only while pending

post.summary: Approve a pending request: the applicant becomes a volunteer of the group. The same decision again returns the stored request
Reject a pending request. The same decision again returns the stored request
